purpose: Define each live service/process instance as a transient runtime identity bound to exact logical service/module instance, artifact revision and environment.

topics.name: Service Runtime Instance Identity
topics.purpose: Define each live service/process instance as a transient runtime identity bound to exact logical service/module instance, artifact revision and environment.

semantics.identity_rule: Each running service process/runtime instance has a distinct runtime identity.
semantics.logical_rule: Runtime instance references exact logical module/service instance.
semantics.process_rule: OS process/container/socket identity is implementation metadata, not canonical logical identity.
semantics.state_rule: Running, ready, healthy and serving are distinct states.
semantics.authority_rule: Process ownership does not grant application authority.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: PID used as stable service identity
same process user grants app rights
